the H3 Holm family is 14, not 15: wall_frac is exactly 1 - floor_frac. And the H3 permutation null is now at the family level. 10 of 14 survive on the row-level null (the corrected form of the first build's '11 of 15'); 8 of 14 survive on the family-level null. ICC 0.355, effective n 97.

the §5 start column is backfilled at report stage (see `reduced`). Against a same-stage start the registered ppo_surrogate editor is worse on 4/6, better on 1/6, tied on 1/6; the first build said 4/6 worse from a MIXED comparison whose correct count was 3/6.

the probe's training-pool surrogate gap is a mean over 139/137 evaluations with an SE of 0.0114/0.0099 (t +6.1/+5.6), not a quantity to test against the per-evaluation 0.102. Surrogate hacking is refuted on the 6-map §5 hold-out (+0.007, SE 0.048) and confirmed on the 276-evaluation training pool.
